spec.description: Every NetCrunch counter currently forwarded for the selected node. If a panel below shows 'No data', the counter is simply not in this list — NetCrunch does not collect it for this device. SNMP gear (routers, switches, printers) typically has only a handful of counters and no Processor/Memory/LogicalDisk objects at all.
spec.title: Counters available on this node

spec.description: How many forwarded counters exist per NetCrunch object for the selected node. A missing object here means the corresponding row below will be empty.
spec.title: Counters by object

spec.description: NetCrunch sensors for the selected node — Windows services, VM state, file-age checks, WMI sensors and so on. These are the checks NetCrunch performs beyond raw performance counters. An empty table means no sensors are configured for this node.
spec.title: Sensors on this node

spec.description: Network services NetCrunch checks on this node (PING, HTTPS, CIFS/SMB, custom ports). Reachability of the node itself is derived from these.
spec.title: Monitored services

spec.description: Any NetCrunch sensor currently reporting a problem across the whole estate, not just the selected node. Useful as a jump-off point when investigating.
